name: edgeToEdge
label: Edge to Edge
description: Flag that determines whether header should grow edge to edge of its width.

name: authenticated
label: Authenticated
description: Flag that determines whether a user is authenticated. Based on authentication the header will render a differe view

name: size
label: Size
description: Determines the size of the header

name: experience
label: Experience
description: Determines between 'default' and 'workspace' experiences; referring to styling differences

name: configurations
label: Configurations
description: Public and Private page configurations to be applied.

name: currentRoute
label: Current Route
description: The route the screen is currently on

name: logoAltText
label: Logo Alternative Text
description: Controls the alternative text for the brand logo.

name: logoSource
label: Logo Source
description: Path to the image that will be used for the brand logo.

name: screenConfigurationLink
label: Screen Configuration Link
description: Link to the screen's configuration page in UIB

name: userName
label: User Name
description: The user name to be displayed.

name: userAvatar
label: User Avatar
description: Path to the User Avatar image to be displayed.
